messages:
Aisha: Hey folks — I'm blocked on onboarding. Running `terraform apply` to create a GKE cluster in project `redwood-eu-onboarding` and get a 403: Permission 'container.clusters.create' denied. Error text mentions org policy preventing region 'europe-west1'. Anyone know who owns org policy or how to get an allowance for first-week testing? tagging infra
Irene (infra): Hi Aisha — welcome! Quick checks: is the billing account attached to the project? Also is the SA you're using from a shared infra project or the project's SA? Can you paste `gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-onboarding` output or at least the SA email?
Aisha: Project is `redwood-eu-onboarding`, SA: `terraform-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Billing shows linked in console but terraform errored before creating resources. Copy of last error:
```
Error: Error creating Cluster: googleapi: Error 403: Permission 'container.clusters.create' denied on resource
```
I tried `gcloud auth list` and I'm using the SA key.
Mike (devops): That error often comes from org policy `constraints/gcp.restrictRegions` (or similar). We recently locked some regions for prod. Can you run:
```
gcloud resource-manager org-policies describe constraints/gcp.restrictRegions --organization=1234567890
```
If `europe-west1` isn't allowed there, we'll need an exception.
Sam: Also confirm the SA has `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the target project and `roles/container.admin` on the project. Terraform running with the SA needs those.
Aisha: Thanks. I don't have org-level perms. Can someone check org policy or grant temporary exception? I'm just trying to spin a tiny test cluster (n1-standard-1, 1 node) for dev env.
Irene (infra): I can file the exception — need a short justification and expected duration. Fill this template and DM me: project id, SA email, exact region(s), estimated expiry (defaults to 7d), and a link to the Terraform plan. Example:
- project: redwood-eu-onboarding
- SA: terraform-runner@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- region: europe-west1
- reason: new hire onboarding + infra tests
- duration: 7d
I'll route to org-policy approvers. cc @Mike (devops) for role checks.
Aisha: Pasted details. Link to terraform plan: https://gist.github.com/aisha/tf-plan
Duration 7d sounds fine.
Cloud Oncall Bot: New ticket created: ORG-POL-2026-1123 — Org policy exception request for redwood-eu-onboarding. Assignee: Irene (infra). ETA 1 business day. :white_check_mark:
Mike (devops): Also left a note — we can pre-check next time by running `gcloud beta resource-config validate` or double-check org policies before terraform. But ok. Irene, if you can expedite, huge help.
Aisha: Appreciate it! One more quick Q — if the exception is approved, do I need any other perms to run terraform? Should I request roles now to speed things up?
Irene (infra): Once exception is done, ask for `roles/container.admin` and `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser` on the project for that SA. We can grant via IAM for 7d as well. I'll include that in the ticket.
Sam: FYI if you need to create service account key in console: IAM -> Service Accounts -> create key -> store in Vault. But prefer Workload Identity for long term.
Aisha: Got it. Thanks everyone!
